About QuakeScope

Students use QuakeScope to explore the location, magnitude and depth of global earthquakes in January 2024.

This is an archived catalog, not a real-time monitoring or warning service. It includes USGS events classified as earthquakes with a reported magnitude of at least 4.5, from January 1 at 00:00 UTC through January 31, 2024. Catalog values may be revised.

Circle color represents depth below the surface. Circle size is a visual cue for reported magnitude; it does not represent energy, damage or affected area. The country basemap is generalized and is intended for global orientation.

All map assets and data load from this website. Filtering, sorting and map rendering run in your browser. There are no API keys, account requirements, analytics trackers or location requests.

Download the GeoJSON dataset · USGS API documentation · Natural Earth public domain terms · Leaflet license

AI assistance: OpenAI Codex helped with application code, interface design, testing and documentation. Data and geographic boundaries come from the credited sources.
